description: Design a custom button with your text, colors, border radius, padding and shadow — then copy the generated CSS and use it anywhere.
howto: Type your button text and pick colors.
Adjust border radius and padding with the sliders.
Toggle a shadow on or off.
Copy the generated CSS and paste it into your site.
title: Button Generator

faqs.q: How do I use the CSS on my website?
faqs.a: Click Copy CSS, then paste the .my-button block into your stylesheet and add class=“my-button” to any button or link element.

faqs.q: Can I make a pill-shaped button?
faqs.a: Yes — drag the border radius slider to its maximum (50px) for a fully rounded pill shape.

faqs.q: Does the shadow work on dark backgrounds?
faqs.a: The default soft black shadow shows best on light backgrounds. You can edit the box-shadow line in the copied CSS to suit your design.
